DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string assembled from the provisioned Sealos PostgreSQL instance.

PORT.description: HTTP port for the Express API and static frontend server.

APP_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID.description: Active key id used for AES-256-GCM application-level encryption.

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEYS.description: Comma-separated base64 encryption keys, for example v1:base64key.

AI_API_BASE.description: Optional default OpenAI-compatible AI API base URL.

FEISHU_WEBHOOK_USER_EMAIL.description: Optional Veges username that receives Feishu webhook output.

FEISHU_WEBHOOK_BASIC_USER.description: Optional HTTP basic auth username for the Feishu webhook route.

FEISHU_WEBHOOK_BASIC_PASSWORD.description: Optional HTTP basic auth password for the Feishu webhook route.

FEISHU_APP_ID.description: Optional Feishu app id for webhook expansion.

FEISHU_APP_SECRET.description: Optional Feishu app secret for webhook expansion.

OSS_ENDPOINT.description: Optional OSS endpoint for package market browsing.

PACKAGE_MARKET_MIDDLEWARE_ROOT.description: Compatibility fallback for middleware discovery roots; YAML page_kinds.middleware.discovery.roots takes precedence.

PACKAGE_MARKET_BASE_OBJECT_TEMPLATE.description: Optional OSS object template for package downloads.

PACKAGE_MARKET_DOWNLOAD_EXPIRE_SECONDS.description: Optional signed URL expiry in seconds.
